main.slogan: Artificial Intelligence for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Diagnosis
main.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths worldwide. This Bachelor's Thesis focuses on the development of an AI-based tool to support early and accurate diagnosis of HCC using liver ultrasound images, aiming to improve clinical practice through accessible and effective technology.

sections.benefit_1: Higher accuracy in detecting hepatocellular carcinoma.
sections.benefit_2: Faster and more efficient diagnosis using AI.
sections.benefit_3: Reduced costs in unnecessary medical tests.
sections.benefit_4: Assistance to healthcare professionals in decision-making.
sections.services_description: I have developed diagnostic tools based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to improve the precision and early detection of hepatocellular carcinoma. The model analyzes liver ultrasound images to support clinical decision-making.
sections.ai_diagnosis_description: The tool analyzes liver ultrasound images to detect and segment hepatocellular carcinoma automatically and accurately.
sections.advanced_nn_description: CNNs trained with medical data have been used to achieve high diagnostic sensitivity and specificity.
sections.medical_collaboration_description: The model has been evaluated using real medical images and reviewed with professional input to ensure clinical relevance.
sections.interactive_platform_description: Includes a web platform that allows users to upload ultrasound images and receive real-time predictions.
sections.tumor_evaluation_description: The AI not only detects the tumor but also assesses its stage and progression to support clinical decisions.
sections.r_and_d_description: This thesis lays the groundwork for future improvements through new deep learning techniques and expanded medical datasets.
sections.ai_description: This project is based on deep learning techniques to enhance diagnostic accuracy in medical imaging.
sections.ai_python_description: I used Python with PyTorch and TensorFlow to train advanced medical image detection models.
sections.opencv_description: OpenCV was used for pre-processing and analyzing ultrasound images.
sections.frontend_description: The web platform was built using modern frontend technologies for a seamless user experience.
sections.backend_description: Custom APIs were created to manage medical data and connect the AI model.
sections.integration_description: The tool is designed to integrate smoothly into medical workflows.
sections.contact_description: Do you have questions or feedback about this thesis? Feel free to get in touch.

models.title: Available AI Models
models.metavir_description: Classifies liver ultrasounds according to the METAVIR scale...
models.hcc_ai_description: Classification model that analyzes ultrasound images to predict liver condition: healthy liver, steatosis, cirrhosis, or hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
models.metavir_ai_description: Classifies liver ultrasounds based on the METAVIR scale (F0 to F4), which assesses the degree of liver fibrosis.
models.segmentator_ai_description: Liver segmentation using YOLO technology. Detects structures such as the liver, vessels, kidneys, and lesions (HCC).

used_submodels.YOLOv11: Advanced optimization of vascular and tumor structures

models.gemini_description: Generative model, optimized through prompt engineering techniques, tailored for assistance in liver health.

help.question1: How do I create a new study?
help.question2: How do I change my password?
help.question3: Where can I see the AI results?
help.question4: Can I download a PDF report?
help.answer1: Go to the My Studies section and click on Create Study.
help.answer2: Go to Settings > Account > Change Password.
help.answer3: Once the analysis is complete, you’ll see the segmented image and results in the study view.
help.answer4: Yes. Once generated, click Download Report in the study menu. It will open in a new tab where you can download or edit it.
